outcome: Admission to a neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: The cohort consists of pregnant women from a national registry in Finland, including 45,718 women aged 35 years or older and 203,930 women aged less than 35 years, with data covering years 2004-2008.
finding: Maternal overweight and obesity, especially in combination with advanced maternal age, significantly increased the risks of adverse pregnancy outcomes including preterm delivery, preeclampsia, foetal death, large for gestational age (LGA), and Caesarean section.
mod_finding: Maternal overweight and obesity, combined with advanced maternal age, significantly increased the risk of Caesarean section.
